findings.highlight: You don't want the procedure? Well, too bad.
findings.evidenceJa: 荒療治はイヤじゃないんでしょ
findings.governingReading: イヤじゃないんでしょ checks his prior statement that treatment is not his objection, then urges acceptance.
findings.explanation: You do not dislike the procedure becomes you do not want it and too bad.

findings.highlight: it's going to take a while because you're old enough
findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮くんの体がもういじれないぐらい成長してたら長くかかる
findings.governingReading: 体が…成長してたら makes the complication conditional until examination.
findings.explanation: A conditional mature-body impediment becomes a definite cause of prolonged treatment.
